blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Senate impeachment court has issued subpoenas to the next set of defense witnesses in Vice President Sara Duterte’s trial, which include officials from the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) and the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), as well as a former investigator at the Anti-Money Laundering Council (AMLC). Duterte’s defense counsel requested on Saturday that the following individuals be issued subpoenas to serve as witnesses to contest Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth: Atty. Rainer Dela Fuente, former Financial Investigator of the AMLC Secretariat Dr. Ceferino Rodolfo, DTI Usec. for Industry Development and Investment Promotions Group Pilar Marilyn […]...
